name: Beth Hogla
overview: Beth Hogla is identified in Scripture as a significant landmark on the northern border of the tribe of Judah's territory, marking part of the boundary lines described in Joshua 15:6 and Joshua 18:19. It is also listed among the cities of the tribe of Benjamin in Joshua 18:21, indicating its location near the border between these tribal lands. These passages emphasize Beth Hogla's role as a border place, highlighting the careful delineation of tribal inheritances in the Promised Land.
